clue.text: Unfortunately curtail rap at beginning of single: here's the details

indicators.note: things going unfortunately go awry, so the words curtail rap are thrown into a new order
the beginning of the word single is just its opening letter

explanation.surface: A grumble that someone has unfortunately cut short a rap at the start of a single release, with the details.
explanation.definitionFit: Particulars are the specific items of information, a plain synonym for details.

clue.text: River in which star is reflected

indicators.note: a reflection shows a mirror image, so the word for the star is read backwards

parts.note: a nova is a star that suddenly flares in brightness

explanation.surface: A river whose surface mirrors a star overhead.
explanation.walkthrough: The Avon is one of several English rivers of that name, the best known flowing through Stratford.
explanation.definitionFit: The Avon is an example of a river in England.

clue.text: Throw at ship

parts.note: to can stand for at, as in 'to the door' meaning at the door
SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: An order to hurl something at a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: To toss something is to throw it lightly, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Black maybe worn by Edward and Mark

indicators.note: something worn wraps round the wearer, so the singer's name goes around the short form of Edward

parts.note: Cilla Black was a British singer and TV presenter; 'maybe' flags her as one example of a Black
Ed is a short form of the name Edward

explanation.surface: Something black being worn by Edward and Mark, two friends in dark clothes.
explanation.walkthrough: Cilla Black was a Liverpool singer and long-running British TV presenter.
explanation.definitionFit: A cedilla is a diacritical mark placed under a letter c, as in façade.

clue.text: Attract student runner from Yorkshire

parts.note: L is a learner, as on the plate of a learner driver
the Ure is a river in Yorkshire, and rivers run

explanation.surface: Tempting a student athlete from Yorkshire to join a team.
explanation.definitionFit: To lure is to tempt or entice, a close synonym of attract.

clue.text: Inform on people in modern society

parts.note: to rat on someone is to betray them to the authorities
a race is a people of shared descent

explanation.surface: Snitching on others is part of life in today's world.
explanation.definitionFit: The rat race is the competitive, frantic struggle of contemporary working life.

clue.text: A very quiet woman morphed into just 'a name'

parts.note: pp, pianissimo, is the musical instruction for very quiet
Ella is a woman's name

indicators.note: morphed means changed shape, so the letters of the word into are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A shy woman has been reduced to nothing more than a label.
explanation.definitionFit: An appellation is a formal word for a title or name by which something is known.

clue.text: Type of pressure we're all under

definitions.text: Type of pressure we're all under

parts.words: Type of pressure we're all under
parts.note: the air above presses on everyone on Earth's surface, so this is the pressure of the air itself

explanation.surface: A sympathetic remark about the stress everybody faces.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests work or social stress; the pressure is literally that of the air we live beneath.
explanation.definitionFit: Atmospheric pressure is the weight of air bearing down on everything below it.

clue.text: See a blemish

definitions.meaning: a small mark or pimple on the skin

explanation.definitionFit: Spot as a verb means notice, and as a noun a skin mark or stain.

clue.text: Conservative team give opinion on performance, being helpful

parts.note: a side is a team in sport
to rate is to judge how well something performs

explanation.surface: A Tory team judging a show and trying to be constructive.
explanation.definitionFit: A considerate person thinks of others' needs, which makes them kind and helpful.

clue.text: Brave warrior: he takes half of Italian city

indicators.note: half of a four-letter city's name is its first two letters

parts.note: Rome is the Italian capital

explanation.surface: A bold fighter seizes half of an Italian city.
explanation.definitionFit: A hero is a person admired for courage, especially in battle.

clue.text: Old dinosaur with three dangerous points to face?

definitions.meaning: a horned plant-eating dinosaur of the late Cretaceous
the name means three-horned face, from Greek, and its head carried three sharp horns

explanation.definitionFit: Triceratops was a prehistoric reptile whose face bore three horns, matching both readings.

clue.text: Rich, posh lass almost organised educational grant

indicators.note: organised means put in order, so these letters are arranged afresh
almost the word lass means it loses its last letter

explanation.surface: A wealthy, well-to-do girl nearly managing to arrange funding for study.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims lass to LAS before it joins the anagram fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A scholarship is money awarded to support a student's studies.

clue.text: In secrecy, cleverly use again

indicators.note: the answer sits inside the words that follow, spanning their boundary

explanation.surface: Secretly and cleverly reusing something.
explanation.definitionFit: To recycle is to process or reuse material rather than discard it.

clue.text: Vote into office and pick leader off

indicators.note: with the leader taken off, the word loses its first letter

parts.note: to select is to pick

explanation.surface: Choosing someone for a post and removing the party chief.
explanation.definitionFit: To elect is to choose a candidate for a position by voting.

clue.text: Surveys returned about calcium in seafood

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the reversed surveys go around the chemical symbol
returned means sent back, so the word for surveys is read backwards

parts.note: polls are opinion surveys
Ca is the chemical symbol for calcium

explanation.surface: Surveys coming back about the calcium content of shellfish.
explanation.definitionFit: A scallop is an edible shellfish, an example of seafood.

clue.text: Leave first of sheep and cows with male animal

indicators.note: the first of each of the two animal words is its opening letter

parts.note: a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: Livestock leaving: sheep and cows head off with a male beast.
explanation.definitionFit: Scram is a slangy order to go away quickly, a synonym of leave.

clue.text: She's a band named after her, maybe backed by a chap named Cooper?

definitions.text: She's a band named after her, maybe backed by a chap named Cooper?

parts.words: She's a band named after her, maybe backed by a chap named Cooper?
parts.note: The clue jokes that a woman is backed by a man called Cooper

explanation.surface: A woman wonders whether a band named after her is backed by someone called Cooper.
explanation.walkthrough: Alice Cooper is the shock-rock singer whose original band carried that name.
explanation.definitionFit: The rock act Alice Cooper puts a woman's first name in front of the surname Cooper.

clue.text: Boast about argument

parts.note: c, short for circa, means about
a row is a quarrel

explanation.surface: Bragging about winning a quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: To crow is to brag or gloat triumphantly.

clue.text: Pigpen, we hear, is an eyesore?

indicators.note: we hear signals the word is judged by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: a sty is an enclosure for pigs

explanation.surface: Asking whether a filthy pigpen counts as an ugly blot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'eyesore' is read literally as a sore on the eye.
explanation.definitionFit: A stye is an inflamed swelling on the eyelid, literally a sore on the eye.

clue.text: Indian perhaps in old vessel crossing Spain

indicators.note: the vessel straddles the letter for Spain, so that letter sits inside it

parts.note: a can is a container
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: Perhaps an Indian travelling in an ancient ship across Spain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Indian' suggests a person; it is the Indian Ocean.
explanation.definitionFit: The Indian is one example of the world's great seas, the oceans.

clue.text: East German supported by well-off person scared to face reality

indicators.note: in a down answer the first part rests on top of the second, which holds it up

parts.note: Ost is the German word for east
rich means wealthy

explanation.surface: An East German, propped up by a wealthy backer, refusing to face facts.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who buries their head in the sand like the bird of legend is called an ostrich.

clue.text: Set forth, and rushed back with speed

indicators.note: back means going backwards, so the word for rushed is reversed

parts.note: ran is a past tense meaning rushed
rate means pace or speed

explanation.surface: Someone set off, then hurried back quickly.
explanation.definitionFit: To narrate is to tell or set forth a story in order.

clue.text: One's honest about celebrity

parts.note: re means concerning or about
the A-list is the top tier of famous people

explanation.surface: Someone being frank about fame.
explanation.definitionFit: A realist is someone who sees things plainly and frankly as they are.

clue.text: Spoil study by independent old electrical engineer

parts.note: to mar is to spoil
to con is an old word for to study

explanation.surface: An old engineer ruining his studies by going it alone.
explanation.definitionFit: Guglielmo Marconi was the Italian engineer who pioneered radio a century ago.

clue.text: Try a game of cricket

explanation.definitionFit: Test means trial as a verb and an international cricket match as a noun.

clue.text: Danger: medication masks bug

indicators.note: the words mask the answer, concealing it across their boundary

explanation.surface: A warning that a medicine hides an infection.
explanation.definitionFit: A germ is a microbe, informally called a bug.

clue.text: It's a pretence when embarrassment's not complete

indicators.note: something not complete is missing its end, so the last letter goes

parts.note: shame is a feeling of embarrassment

explanation.surface: Feigning things when one's embarrassment is only partial.
explanation.definitionFit: A sham is something fake, a deception or pretence.

clue.text: Against a new note?

parts.note: ti is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Opposing a fresh memo.
explanation.definitionFit: Anti means opposed to, a direct synonym of against.

clue.text: Device for telling pub-goers to drink up: in the past, or the future?

definitions.text: Device for telling pub-goers to drink up: in the past, or the future?

parts.words: Device for telling pub-goers to drink up: in the past, or the future?
parts.note: a landlord calls closing time, so a gadget calling it would be a clock-based machine; the second part points to travel through history

explanation.surface: A gadget that signals last orders in a pub, wondering whether it belongs to yesterday or tomorrow.
explanation.walkthrough: In British pubs the barman calls 'Time!' when it is time to finish drinks and leave.
explanation.definitionFit: A time machine is the science-fiction device that carries people into the past or future.

clue.text: French bread causing tummy ache?

definitions.meaning: an ache in the stomach is a kind of physical hurt

explanation.definitionFit: Pain is French for bread, and in English means suffering such as a stomach ache.

clue.text: Servant combining charm with bed? I am!

indicators.note: combining means mixing together, so these letters are blended into a new order

explanation.surface: A maid boasting that she blends charm with bedmaking.
explanation.definitionFit: A chambermaid is a domestic worker who cleans and makes up bedrooms.
